issues.reproduction: Patrol, no ride, no attached rope, player y=770 and vy=320, optional encounter 100 world units ahead. Original controlCue returned a ready pickup cue rather than danger recovery. Repeat for all four vehicle ids.
issues.expected: The dangerous descending free flight requests a rope catch before advertising optional rewards. If input is already held, say keep holding rather than ask for another press.
acceptance: Four vehicle approach states return danger recovery
Upward low pass remains eligible for its own cue

issues.reproduction: Attached to a real roof, player 44 units ahead of its anchor, vx=205, vy=-35 and pursuing guard 280 units behind. An optional vehicle 500 units ahead hid the existing release-before-reversal warning.
issues.expected: The real impending reversal has priority over pickup preparation; show release now with actual urgency.
acceptance: Warning visible for all four optional encounters
No automatic release, speed or collision changes

issues.reproduction: Bird 1500 world units ahead, one earned stylish release, real held roof rope, player past anchor with vx=400 and vy=-190. Original cue only showed the preparation count and hid the immediate scoreable release timing.
issues.expected: The earned preparation count and the genuine release-now window share one short cue; slow unqualified motion never says release now.
acceptance: Real qualifying rope state shows release now and 1/2
Unqualified speed does not show a scoring cue

issues.reproduction: Mounted on a kite, a lantern offer is 800 world units ahead. V2 cannot claim another ride while mounted, yet the goal advertised grabbing it.
issues.expected: Hide the redundant future pickup goal while mounted; keep ride badge, remaining time and actual controls.
acceptance: Mounted ride has no conflicting future-pickup goal
